scope: Municipal/comarca hiking records whose official or institutional source documents the route but exposes no authoritative public GPX/KML/KMZ artifact located during the audit

sources.finding: The municipal page names the four walking routes around Navalcan, but no public GPX/KML/KMZ artifact was located from the official source.
The municipal natural-heritage page documents the named hiking itineraries, but no public GPX/KML/KMZ artifact was located from that authority.

sources.authority: Ayuntamiento de La Guardia de Jaen
sources.finding: The municipal tourism source describes the Cerrillo de San Cristobal / Cueva Cabrera itinerary, but no authoritative downloadable geometry was located.

The municipal natural-heritage source confirms the botanical/didactic trail at Desfiladero de Puerta Arenas, but no public GPX/KML/KMZ artifact was located. Access-distance text on the page is not promoted to hiking-track geometry.

sources.authority: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
sources.finding: The institutional page documents the Puente de Tierra hiking access and approximate circular/out-and-back distances but exposes no authoritative public GPX/KML/KMZ artifact located in this audit. Community and third-party tracks exist but are deliberately excluded from official evidence.

closure_note: These findings close the current public-source discovery pass for the five remaining municipal/comarca source sets. They do not assert that the authorities hold no internal geometry; they assert that no authoritative public artifact was located and prevent community tracks or guessed URLs from being promoted as official evidence.
